lines.text: An angel sends Philip south to the desert road from Jerusalem to Gaza, where he meets an Ethiopian eunuch.
The treasury official had gone to Jerusalem to worship and was reading Isaiah in his chariot.
An angel tells Philip to go to the chariot, and Philip runs up and hears the man reading Isaiah.
The eunuch asks whom the prophet means, and Philip tells him the good news about Moses.
Philip baptizes the eunuch in the water, then the Spirit carries Philip away and he appears at Azotus.
